text: The parsed HTML MIME class buffers input and parses the complete HTML document at EOF through DOMParser::ParseFromStringInternal. It removes refresh metadata, optionally removes conditional CSS, serializes the DOM, and sends the normalized text to its superclass before clearing the buffer. Preserve the complete pipeline when adapting an upstream parser API. The port proves a call-site change; it does not establish a full Trusted Types or mail security audit. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep MIME HTML normalization as a whole-document phase
